en-US.description: Upload one garment image, choose a style input mode, and generate marketing-oriented clothing visuals with one click.
en-US.empty.customStylePrompt: Please enter a style prompt first
en-US.empty.styleReferenceImages: Upload at least 1 style reference image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.generationMode.advanced.desc: Enhance fabric texture, structure details, and marketing-grade finish.
en-US.generationMode.reference.desc: Upload multiple style reference images and AI will use them one by one to guide flat-lay presentation or garment detail display.
en-US.generationMode.standard.desc: Balanced quality and speed for everyday marketing output.
en-US.generationMode.custom.desc: Describe the desired presentation in text.
en-US.label: Clothing Variations
en-US.placeholder.customStylePrompt: Enter style instructions, for example: extract the lower garment from the image and generate a neatly arranged marketing flat-lay. Use a wrinkled white fabric background...
en-US.upload.garmentImage: Click to upload a garment image
en-US.upload.garmentImage.help: Supports one flat-lay image, mannequin image, or model image. AI will preserve the garment itself and only change the marketing presentation.
en-US.upload.styleReferenceImages.help: Upload multiple style reference images. AI will reference their flat-lay presentation, garment detail emphasis, and visual expression one by one without changing the garment itself.

zh-CN.description: 上传 1 张服饰图，选择样式输入方式，一键生成营销化服饰展示图。
zh-CN.empty.garmentImage: 请先上传 1 张服饰图
zh-CN.empty.styleReferenceImages: 请先上传至少 1 张样式参考图
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.generationMode.advanced.desc: 增强面料纹理、结构细节与营销成片质感。
zh-CN.generationMode.custom.desc: 用文字描述你想要的服饰展示效果。
zh-CN.generationMode.reference.desc: 上传多张样式参考图，生成时会逐张参考其平铺陈列或细节展示方式。
zh-CN.generationMode.standard.desc: 平衡生成效率与营销展示完成度。
zh-CN.label: 百变服饰图
zh-CN.placeholder.customStylePrompt: 输入样式描述内容，如：提取图中下装服饰，生成标准摆放的平铺图。背景为带褶皱的白布，并补充具有营销感的展示细节。
zh-CN.upload.garmentImage.help: 支持上传单张平铺图、人台图或模特图。AI 会保留服饰本身，只调整营销化展示方式。
zh-CN.upload.styleReferenceImages.help: 支持上传多张样式参考图，生成时会参考其平铺陈列方式、细节展示重点与画面表达，但不会改变主服饰款式。
